palette.title: Devices
palette.hint: Drag a device onto the canvas, or click it to add it in the middle.
palette.touchHint: Touch and hold a device to see its ports and when to use it.
palette.emptyFavourites: No favourites yet. Point at a device and press the star in its card.
palette.emptyRecent: The devices you add show up here.
palette.detailsHint: Point at a device or move to it with the arrow keys to see its ports and when to use it.
palette.gridHint: Arrow keys move between devices, Enter adds one.
palette.cableHint: Pick a cable, then click two devices. The toolbar above the canvas has the same cables.

cableDescriptions.auto: Picks the right cable for the two ports you click.
cableDescriptions.copperStraight: Different device types: PC, printer or router to a switch.
cableDescriptions.copperCross: Same device types directly: switch to switch, PC to PC.
cableDescriptions.fiber: Fiber ports (SFP uplinks), also over long distances.
cableDescriptions.serial: Serial WAN line between two routers; your first click is the DCE.
cableDescriptions.console: From a PC to the console port of a router or switch, for management.
cableDescriptions.wireless: Joins a Wi-Fi client to the SSID of an access point.

cableHints.firstDeviceSerial: {{cable}}: click the first device. Its end is the DCE (provides the clock).
cableHints.secondDevice: {{cable}} from {{device}} {{port}}: now click the second device.

ssidPicker.title: Join a wireless network
ssidPicker.label: SSID (network name)
ssidPicker.hint: Pick a network of the access point or type a name.
ssidPicker.noOptions: This access point offers no SSIDs yet; type the name the client should use.

cableRefusal.sameDevice: A cable cannot join two ports of the same device.
cableRefusal.cableDoesNotFitPort: This cable's connector does not fit that port.
cableRefusal.wirelessNeedsClientAndRadio: A wireless connection joins a client's Wi-Fi card to an access point radio.
cableRefusal.portInUse: That port is already in use.
cableRefusal.consoleNeedsTerminal: A console cable joins a computer to a device's console port.
cableRefusal.ssidRequired: Enter the name of the wireless network (SSID).
cableRefusal.crossoverRequired: Auto-MDIX is off on both ports and they use the same wiring: use a crossover cable.
cableRefusal.straightThroughRequired: Auto-MDIX is off on both ports and they use different wiring: use a straight-through cable.

canvas.label: Lab canvas
canvas.empty: Drag devices here from the device list to start building your lab.

properties.title: Properties
properties.notesHint: Your own notes about this lab. They are saved with the lab.
properties.settingsHidden: The settings of this device are hidden in this exercise.
properties.selectHint: Select a device to see its information, settings and terminal.

annotation.label: Note: {{text}}
annotation.editHint: Double-click or press Enter to edit

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.escape: Cancel the cable step / clear the selection
shortcuts.connectFocused: With the cable tool: open the ports of the focused device
